<ul class="digest-points">

<ul class="digest-points">

  <li><strong>Political Disputes:</strong> AAP and BJP are engaged in a heated confrontation over the inclusion of Raghav Chadha in the Delhi voters&#x27; list, while the Congress party faces internal friction regarding its allies&#x27; stances on national symbols and ongoing protests against Punjab ministers.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxNR2lCVGpIQnZUSmpDSGVKaVhaSE9xWlc2V1BZOVM1ZTNvZndvc1JBcnltVnpWd0E5UmpLTGxkLV80TmZPcXN4M3Z5NTNfdThHQUNfUFhMMlpvcGRvVVdtUUhOQ2hnZ3NHUy05bGxDZTlpYnZqRk8xNWkwa19UVzdzU1hhMWxiZzJWOFMwZHpoZzJBWWdsR050SG1zNUk5T0tFSmZBU01DWEJROFE?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W11</a></span></li>
